messages:
elaine-pm: FYI — NovaHealth (pilot prospect) just dropped a combined HIPAA + GDPR questionnaire. They want: data residency by region, per-customer retention windows (7/30/365 days), access to raw audit logs, and KMS/HSM key ownership options. Can we triage?

sam-sales: Thanks Elaine — sales ask: they want this clarified before we sign a pilot MSA. Timeline: legal asked for answers in 5 business days. They’re okay with a limited pilot if we can promise data separation + exportable audit logs.

jordan-sec: Quick notes from security POV:
- KMS integration is supported for Private deployments today; hosted needs KMS-as-a-service gating.
- Audit logs exist but default retention is 30d; extending to 365d is nontrivial on hosted without dedicated retention tier.
- Data residency: we can pin regionally in Dedicated/Private. Hosted can route to region but we need controls for backups.

jordan-sec: Suggested mitigations:
```
1) Offer Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS for pilot.
2) Provide exportable, gzipped audit bundles on request (S3 presigned) for up to 365d.
3) Add contractual retention options with extra fee for long-term storage.
```

maya-pm: To put this into our intake flow — we need: acceptance criteria, launch gating, and an estimated story list. Elena/Sam, can you confirm which asks are non-negotiable vs negotiable? Also, what level of engineering SLA does the customer expect?

sam-sales: Non-negotiables per customer: region pinning (EU data stays in EU), audit log access for compliance team, and KMS control. Retention window they said "may accept 30d for pilot" but want 365d in contract. SLA: they asked for 99.9% availability for inference endpoints during pilot hours.

devon-eng: From infra side: baseline estimates — exposing exportable audit bundles: 1 week to prototype, 2-3 sprints to harden for scale. 365d retention on hosted: depends on storage tier; could be ~+20-30% recurring cost and needs a retention pipeline + index pruning. Region pinning for backups: 1 sprint to validate for Dedicated, 3+ for hosted (legal/regulatory review).

maya-pm: OK — propose triage decision here:
- Scope for pilot (must-have): Private or Dedicated deployment + KMS + audit bundle export (30d retention for pilot).
- Post-pilot backlog item: hosted 365d retention tier, hosted KMS integration, long-term log indexing.

elaine-pm: Agree. I'll tell the customer we can do pilot with Private + KMS + 30d audit exports and negotiate 365d as a contract add-on. Need customer-signed pilot SOW by EOD Friday. Sam — can you get that?

sam-sales: On it. Drafting SOW today, will route to legal.

jordan-sec: Action items from sec:
- Provide a short whitepaper on KMS options & threats model (owner: jordan-sec, due in 48h).
- Inventory of current audit log fields + retention implications (owner: devon-eng, due in 72h).

ops-bot: :page_facing_up: Created intake ticket RW-4721 for NovaHealth compliance triage. Link: https://redwood-internal/ops/tickets/RW-4721

maya-pm: I'll add RW-4721 to this quarter's operational triage board as "sales-critical pilot" and create two backlog epics: PRIV-Pilot (pilot work) and HOST-Retention (hosted retention features).

elaine-pm: Thanks everyone. One more: Sam, please confirm whether they will permit a dedicated cluster in our EU partner region (we may need partner contract signoff).

sam-sales: Confirmed — they prefer EU partner region, I'll confirm partner contract acceptance today.

devon-eng: Noted. I'll scope a minimal infra diagram for Private pilot and add rough cost delta for retention options.

elaine-pm: Great. We'll reconvene in 48h after Jordan/Devon deliverables. :thumbsup:
